title: Agent books on the customer's behalf — no customer sign-in

state.product: Zenno — universal booking layer making local appointment businesses bookable by AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Siri). Hamburg first.
state.founder_requirement: Customers must NOT have to sign in or create an account. The AI chat, discovery surface or agent books the service for the customer. Zenno is invisible infrastructure, not a consumer brand the customer logs into.

facts.public_web_form_today: Zenno's existing public booking form on every business site already creates bookings with no login, no key and no account — only name, email and phone, pay at venue. So a keyless agent booking carries the same risk as a person using the website.
facts.current_agent_api: Search and business details are public. Availability, hold, book, cancel, reschedule require a per-business key, so one assistant cannot book everywhere. Slot holds expire, Jev blocks unclear booking requests, merchant can require approval, every action is audit-logged, merchant gets an email per booking.
facts.cancel_today: Cancel/reschedule require the booking id plus the customer's email.
facts.rejected_options: Customer OAuth sign-in (founder rejected: customers do not want to sign in). A single platform key able to book at every business was refused by the coding assistant's safety mode as a broad credential.

research.web_bot_auth: Web Bot Auth (HTTP Message Signatures, RFC 9421) lets an AI agent prove its identity on each request with a public-key signature and a Signature-Agent header; the site verifies against the vendor's published key directory, no shared secret. OpenAI's ChatGPT agent signs with Signature-Agent https://chatgpt.com; Google started in June 2026; Shopify authenticates agents with it since May 2026; backed by Cloudflare, Amazon, Akamai, IETF working group chartered 2026.
research.mcp_and_chatgpt_apps: MCP authorization is optional; ChatGPT apps may run with No Auth or Mixed auth. Local MCP clients such as Claude Desktop or Cursor generally do not sign requests with Web Bot Auth.
research.reserve_with_google: Google books across many merchants through a partner with one contracted credential.

booking_access_model.instructions: Which access model should Zenno's agent booking use, honouring `state.founder_requirement` and the facts in `state`?

criteria.open_like_web_form_with_verified_tier: Anyone's agent can search, hold and book without keys or sign-in, exactly like the public web form, with the same protections plus: slot holds, per-IP and per-agent rate limits, Jev intent gate, merchant approval option, audit log, and a confirmation email to the customer with a cancel link. Agents that prove identity with Web Bot Auth (ChatGPT, Google, etc.) get higher rate limits and a 'booked via ChatGPT' label for the merchant.
criteria.verified_agents_only: Only agents that prove identity with Web Bot Auth may hold and book; all unsigned clients (including Claude Desktop, Cursor, custom bots) can only search.
criteria.customer_email_confirmation_required: No keys, but every agent booking stays unconfirmed until the customer clicks a link in an email.

cancel_protection.instructions: Without keys or sign-in, how should an agent be allowed to cancel or reschedule a booking?

criteria.booking_id_plus_email: Keep today's rule: booking id plus the customer's email, which the agent already knows from the conversation. The customer gets an email for every change so mistakes are visible.
criteria.secret_manage_token: Return a secret manage token only to the agent that made the booking and in the customer's confirmation email; cancel/reschedule require that token.
criteria.email_link_only: Agents cannot cancel; only the customer via the email link.
